correctness.rationale: The rank-≤6 locus of projective skew 10-by-10 forms is irreducible of codimension six, smooth away from rank ≤4 (codimension 15). A general P9 avoids the latter, meets the smooth stratum transversely, and cuts no new singularities on the rank-eight stratum. In a rank-six chart, the Pfaffian is an invertible factor times the quadratic Pfaffian of the four-dimensional Schur complement. Its normal Hessian is nondegenerate; hence the restricted Jacobian generators span the conormal of the transverse slice and generate its reduced ideal locally. The kernel incidence is an isomorphism over the rank-six stratum. Determinants, using projectivization of lines, give K_Z=−5g−15h, so 35 hyperplane cuts give −5g+20H. The nondegenerate alternating form on the six-dimensional quotient with values in O(H) trivializes det(Q*)⊗O(3H); g=3H on S and K_S=5H. Checked all four integers independently: on P9×Gr(4,10), the same kernel incidence is the regular zero set of E=(Λ²V*/Λ²Q*)⊗O(1), of rank 30. Integrating c_top(E) times the virtual tangent Chern classes using formal P9 hyperplane degree and 210 Grassmannian fixed points returned (330,−1650,7920,−31350), using exact rationals and Newton identities (python3 /workspace/review-evidence/check_frozen.py, pfaffian). The independent method is not an execution of the frozen 3150-point checker. HRR and Gauss–Bonnet give exactly the asserted polynomial, K³ and Euler characteristics. Only general slices are verified.

evidence: A general Hilbert-series formula for Pfaffian rings, with their CM and Gorenstein properties recorded. Explicit CSM polynomials for skew corank strata and the precise projectivization rule α_i→ξ/2; general-linear-section Euler characteristics are recoverable from CSM data.
The newer skew-corank CSM paper provides another stable general formula.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Use the ideal generated by the 8-by-8 Pfaffians in a generic 10-by-10 matrix; 35 general linear equations on its coordinate ring form a regular sequence and preserve Gorenstein. Separately the projective rank-≤6 locus is a union of the nonzero corank 4,6,8 strata in P44. The explicit orbit CSM classes add and determine each general section Euler characteristic by the published formula.

evidence: Let e_j be the Euler characteristic of the codimension-j general slice of the projective rank-≤6 locus. Explicit skew-orbit CSM and the general-section Euler transform give e_35,e_36,e_37,e_38 directly, without any special theorem about this threefold.

The Pfaffian Hilbert series specializes and is multiplied by (1−t)^35. Since S is arithmetically Gorenstein, K_S=O_S(a). Serre duality implies P(m)=−P(a−m); comparing the quadratic and cubic coefficients of the specialized Hilbert polynomial gives a=5.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: By smooth hyperplane adjunction, H³=e_38, c1H²=e_37+2e_38, c2H=e_36+e_37+e_38 and c3=e_35. Thus c3, which HRR alone cannot recover, and the rest of the Chern table are explicitly formula-determined. K³, χ(O) and the numerical Hilbert polynomial require only the already determined data or the graded series. The review's numerical reproduction used a different incidence calculation, not an independent expansion of the CSM orbit sums.

originality.rationale: No inspected source prints this complete exact table, but the numerical claims are mechanical specializations of published general formulas for projectivized skew rank strata and Euler characteristics of their general linear sections. Generic Pfaffian ring Hilbert series and the Gorenstein property also cover the Hilbert polynomial and the canonical line. The exact computation checks the table; it does not establish a new invariant distinct from those formulas.
residual_risks: No exact printed specialization was found in the inspected passages. The Harris–Tu full text was not accessible through the attempted lawful routes; coverage of the full numerical claim does not depend on that access. The older quartic mirror was unavailable and not used as proof of overlap.
